channel.name: ReSpOnSe Gaming AND Fitness AND AI Music

notes: Landscape, self-owned SC2 gameplay only. Menus, long pauses, BRB screens, scoreboards, portrait duplicates, and third-party watch-party footage were excluded.

clips.title: Mineral-Line Melee
clips.notes: A red bio force crashes into the defended mineral line; the range opens on approach and exits as the first wave breaks.

clips.title: Beamstorm at the Ramp
clips.notes: A concentrated beam exchange at the ramp, ending before the game transition.

clips.title: Golden Fleet Collision
clips.notes: Large Protoss air groups converge at mid-map and trade sustained fire.

clips.title: Snowfield Counterpush
clips.notes: A mixed ground-and-air army turns defense into a forceful counterpush through a snowy choke.

clips.title: Laser Wall on the Creep
clips.notes: Sustained green beam volleys cut through a large Zerg force with almost no dead time.

videos.title: GM Protoss TRYING TO IMPROVE — 2026-08-16
videos.notes: The third-party tournament/watch-party section around 47:00–136:00 is intentionally excluded.

clips.title: Holding the Dark Approach
clips.notes: Purposeful defensive positioning and early contact on the dark approach.

clips.title: First Serious Move-Out
clips.notes: The army crosses center and applies the first sustained pressure.

clips.title: Terran Base Break and GG
clips.notes: A base assault drives through the defense into the game-ending payoff.

clips.title: Carrier Raid Through the Terran Production Line
clips.notes: The fleet enters the Terran base, focus-fires production and defenders, then rotates out.

clips.title: Max-Supply Carrier Fleet vs. Terran Air
clips.notes: A 198/200-supply fleet collides with the Terran air screen and sustains pressure before the BRB boundary.

clips.title: Crossfire at the Dark Choke
clips.notes: The armies meet in a narrow lane for a continuous crossfire.

clips.title: Last Clash Before the Scoreboard
clips.notes: The game's final concentrated engagement, cut before postgame.

clips.title: Greenfield Airburst
clips.notes: The Protoss force dives into a red formation amid repeated beams and explosions.

clips.title: Final Sweep Through the Grasslands
clips.notes: A short windup becomes the decisive final sweep.

clips.title: Red Flyers Meet the Prism Wall
clips.notes: Red air units run into layered Protoss fire and strong beam effects.

clips.title: Prismatic Beam Barrage
clips.notes: Multiple beam units rake a large red army across the industrial map.

clips.title: Second-Wave Breakthrough
clips.notes: The follow-up army crashes into a second formation with air and ground fire.

clips.title: Interceptor Screen at the Outer Base
clips.notes: The fleet launches and catches incoming flyers before the fight disperses.

clips.title: Victory Push Through the Bio Wall
clips.notes: A compact Protoss formation punches through a dense bio line into victory.

clips.title: Last Base, Last Push
clips.notes: The final advance clears the remaining defenders as the win lands.

clips.title: Laser Storm at the Nexus
clips.notes: A sustained Protoss-versus-Zerg Nexus fight with a clean disengage.

clips.title: Carrier Ball Breaks the Natural

clips.title: Snowfield Surround

clips.title: Swarm at the Front Door

clips.title: Battle Across the Ice

clips.title: Warp-In Under Fire
clips.notes: A base-edge fight escalates with reinforcements and focus fire.

clips.notes: A large fleet advances through tanks and bio into the defended pocket.
